_about: rank1's architecture (search trial ea7d1f8f: 81 ch 3x3 then 56 ch 5x5, each pooled, 48x48, T=16) retrained for 300 epochs with weight decay 0.001, as in the top-five replay, with pool_type=avg. Average pooling folds into the classifier, whose fan-in becomes 32,256, so this does NOT fit the chip; it is the baseline for the max-pool version.
